#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect report.pdf: existence, page count, page size, and metadata."""
import os
from pypdf import PdfReader

path = "report.pdf"
print(f"File exists: {os.path.exists(path)}")
print(f"File size: {os.path.getsize(path) if os.path.exists(path) else 'N/A'} bytes")

if os.path.exists(path):
    reader = PdfReader(path)
    print(f"Page count: {len(reader.pages)}")
    if len(reader.pages) > 0:
        page = reader.pages[0]
        print(f"First page size (pts): {float(page.mediabox.width) if page.mediabox.width else 'N/A'} x {float(page.mediabox.height) if page.mediabox.height else 'N/A'}")
    meta = reader.metadata
    if meta:
        print(f"Title: {meta.title}")
        print(f"Author: {meta.author}")
    else:
        print("No metadata")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf: title 'Annual Financial Report' and current date."""
import sys
from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas


def build_cover(page_size) -> str:
    cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
    width, height = page_size
    c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=(width, height))
    # Title centered vertically, date below it
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height * 0.60, "Annual Financial Report")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height * 0.52, date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y"))
    c.save()
    return cover_path


def main() -> int:
    try:
        reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - error reporting
        print(f"ERROR opening report.pdf: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    first = reader.pages[0].mediabox
    page_size = (float(first.width), float(first.height))

    cover_path = build_cover(page_size)
    cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open("report.pdf", "wb") as out:
        writer.write(out)

    print(f"OK: added cover page ({cover_path}) to report.pdf -> total pages: {len(writer.pages)}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf: 'Annual Financial Report' + current date.

Builds the cover with reportlab if available, otherwise with a minimal
pure-Python PDF writer, then merges it ahead of the original pages and
re-writes report.pdf in place.
"""
import sys
from datetime import date
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter


def escape_pdf_text(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_manual(path: str, w: float, h: float, title: str, date_str: str) -> None:
    title_esc = escape_pdf_text(title)
    date_esc = escape_pdf_text(date_str)
    # Approximate Helvetica advance widths for rough centering.
    x1 = max(20.0, (w - 0.55 * 28.0 * len(title)) / 2.0)
    x2 = max(20.0, (w - 0.50 * 16.0 * len(date_str)) / 2.0)
    y1 = h * 0.60
    y2 = h * 0.52

    data = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F4 28 Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {x1:.2f} {y1:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({title_esc}) Tj\n"
        "/F5 16 Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {x2:.2f} {y2:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({date_esc}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    ).encode("ascii")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {w:.2f} {h:.2f}] "
            f"/Resources << /Font << /F4 4 0 R /F5 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"
        ).encode("ascii"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        (
            f"<< /Length {len(data)} >>\nstream\n".encode("ascii")
            + data
            + b"\nendstream"
        ),
    ]

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode("ascii") + obj + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {len(objects) + 1}\n".encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets[1:]:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii")
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode("ascii")
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(out)


def build_cover(path: str, w: float, h: float, title: str, date_str: str) -> None:
    try:
        from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas as rl_canvas

        c = rl_canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=(w, h))
        c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
        c.drawCentredString(w / 2.0, h * 0.60, title)
        c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
        c.drawCentredString(w / 2.0, h * 0.52, date_str)
        c.save()
    except Exception:
        build_cover_manual(path, w, h, title, date_str)


def main() -> int:
    try:
        reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - error reporting
        print(f"ERROR opening report.pdf: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    if len(reader.pages) == 0:  # pragma: no cover - safety
        print("ERROR: report.pdf has no pages", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    box = reader.pages[0].mediabox
    w, h = float(box.width), float(box.height)
    today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    build_cover("cover_page.pdf", w, h, "Annual Financial Report", today)

    cover = PdfReader("cover_page.pdf")
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open("report.pdf", "wb") as out:
        writer.write(out)

    # Validate the written file.
    check = PdfReader("report.pdf")
    first_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").replace("\n", " | ")
    print(f"date used: {today}")
    print(f"page size: {w:.1f} x {h:.1f}")
    print(f"total pages after cover: {len(check.pages)}")
    print(f"page 1 text: {first_text}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
